text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Commitment for Application You can download a template or sample from here . * 2. Video Applicants must upload a self-introduction video of no more than three minutes in length, the content of which must include three parts: a self-introduction (in Chinese); a statement of your interest to study in China, your desire to apply to PKU and which major you’d like to apply to (in English); and your application and registration commitment statement (reading the provided text word for word). The video must be in mp4 format, no larger than 50MB in size. You may decrease the file size if necessary by using video format conversion software (by adjusting the resolution, bit rate, etc.) * 3. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included (passport type must be ordinary) * 4. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 5. Senior High school academic transcript Official transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. Senior High school graduate certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Personal statement * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
